meaning.en: Type E socket (CEE 7/5, French socket with an earth pin; household AC in France, Belgium, Poland and the Czech Republic), shown as the socket face seen from the front
meaning.de: Typ-E-Steckdose (CEE 7/5, französische Steckdose mit Erdungsstift; Haushalt, AC, in Frankreich, Belgien, Polen und Tschechien), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn

standard.source: CEE 7/5 and NF C 61-314 not consulted; layout checked against a public drawing on Wikimedia Commons, retrieved 2026-11-17: "File:Type E Socket.svg" by Aeroid (public domain; socket face: round recess 39 mm, two contact holes on the horizontal centre line 19 mm apart, earth pin of 5 mm diameter 10.2 mm above the centre at 12 h), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Type_E_Socket.svg. Recess and holes as in plug-schuko (same drawing series); the earth pin scales to 4.7 above the centre and is drawn at y 7.25 as a ring r 1.5 (the drawing's 5 mm pin scales to r 1.15; slightly larger so that its counter stays open and it reads as a pin, not a hole), 2.75 below the rim. Socket face exception (design guide section 5): Type E has no vehicle inlet.
